title: One row of compare.tsv (columns in this order)
description: Rows sorted by snapshot, status (match, extra, absent, unobserved, differs, out_of_scope — the closed list of ADR-0123 доп. (2) п. 2; out_of_scope means no applicable scope or pair and is not a negative result), fuzzy, unit. Units: flag:-<name>, env:<NAME>, const:<pkg>.<Name>, help:-<name> (static vs -h), pair:<code> <kind>, fields:<code> <kind> <schema>, word:<word>, reason:<norm ref>/<n> (sub-reason of a Н4 row), error:<word>, row:<norm ref>.

status.description: unobserved: run snapshot only, the checking step was executed but the fact was not met; otherwise out_of_scope

fuzzy.description: 1: the pairing is a heuristic (prose, tokens, partial word)

spec_ref.description: P/NN.N Нk #row, or openapi METHOD path code

code_ref.description: file:line relative to the module root
